saveClockAndRetailLoadRuns.script:
wait 60
devmap tutorial
wait 180
save clock_first
wait 240
load clock_first
wait 10
save clock_reload
screenshot clock_reload
wait 240
maptransition borg2
wait 60
save clock_transition
screenshot clock_transition
loadtransition tutorial
wait 60
save clock_hub_fallback
loadtransition borg2
wait 10
save clock_hub_restore
screenshot clock_hub_restore
wait 3
echo CLOCK_SAVE_COMPLETE
quit

wait 60
load clock_first
wait 120
save clock_retail_reload
screenshot clock_retail_reload
wait 3
echo CLOCK_SAVE_COMPLETE
quit

retailResaveOutcome: Refused while dead after loading fnTech3 save and on fresh retail-only map; not counted as a successful re-save. Both render 100 health; cause unproven in this private-desktop harness.

manualPreflight.script:
wait 60
load mdr_scene
wait 180
renderer_switch
screenshot preflight
wait 3
echo MANUAL_PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE
quit

wait 60
set sv_pure 0
set g_gametype 0
set sv_maxclients 4
map hm_borg1
wait 120
addbot Munro 2
wait 180
renderer_switch
screenshot preflight
wait 3
echo MANUAL_PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE
quit
